title: Loaded hints leave the decision and its copy untouched

rule.title: Retry cap refused
rule.what: The call has been attempted {{ example.attempts }} times.
rule.cause: The host's retry accounting shows the same call replayed without a change of approach.
rule.why: Repeating a refused call spends the session's budget on the same refusal.
rule.fix: {% if example.breaker_open %}The host's circuit breaker is open; wait for it to reset before calling again.{% else %}Change the approach — inspect the environment or ask for the specific slice you need — before calling again.{% endif %}
rule.instead: The host has applied {{ example.redaction_count }} redactions to earlier output; ask for the unredacted slice by name if you need it.

hints.title: Tool output spill capped
hints.what: The tool's output was capped before it reached the model.
hints.cause: The host caps retained tool output so one call cannot crowd out the conversation.
hints.why: Uncapped output hides the part that matters and spends context on repetition.
hints.fix: Ask for the specific slice you need instead of the whole result.

hints.title: Tool output truncated
hints.what: The tool's output was cut off partway through.
hints.cause: The host truncates retained tool output at a size limit.
hints.why: The tail of a long result is usually the least informative part.
hints.fix: Ask for the tail explicitly, or narrow the call so the result fits.

hints.title: Workflow phase exit required
hints.what: The current workflow phase must end before this action is available.
hints.cause: The host sequences work in phases and gates actions by phase.
hints.why: Acting across a phase boundary leaves the phase's own steps unfinished.
hints.fix: Finish the phase's remaining steps, or ask the user to move the phase forward.

hints.title: Secret redacted
hints.what: A secret was redacted from content on its way out.
hints.cause: The host redacts recognized secrets before content leaves the session.
hints.why: The redaction is a receipt, not a failure — the content is safe to use.
hints.fix: Continue with the redacted content; ask the user for the value by name if it is needed.

copy.what: The call has been attempted 3 times.
copy.cause: The host's retry accounting shows the same call replayed without a change of approach.
copy.why: Repeating a refused call spends the session's budget on the same refusal.
copy.fix: The host's circuit breaker is open; wait for it to reset before calling again.
copy.instead: The host has applied 2 redactions to earlier output; ask for the unredacted slice by name if you need it.
